summary: Interface to any USB/Bluetooth Human Interface Device (HID) under macOS standalone Electron context.

ports.name: Active
ports.text: Enable or disable global HID monitoring loop.

ports.name: Target Vendor ID
ports.text: Filter incoming reports by target Vendor ID (e.g. 0x2dc8 for 8BitDo).

ports.name: Target Product ID
ports.text: Filter incoming reports by target Product ID.

ports.name: Target Serial Number
ports.text: Optional serial number filter if multiple identical devices are connected.

ports.name: Write Output
ports.text: Trigger to write an output or feature report to the matched device.

ports.name: Output Report Type
ports.text: Choose between sending standard Output reports or Feature reports.

ports.name: Output Report ID
ports.text: The report ID to use when writing.

ports.name: Output Report Data
ports.text: Array of byte values (0-255) to write to the device.

ports.name: Devices
ports.text: List of currently connected HID devices on the system.

ports.name: On Report
ports.text: Fires when a new input report is received from the matched target device.

ports.name: Report ID
ports.text: The report ID of the received input report.

ports.name: Report Data
ports.text: Array containing the raw bytes of the received input report.

ports.name: Status
ports.text: Current status of the HID monitoring connection.

ports.name: Is Connected
ports.text: True if the target device is connected.
